name: Secobarbital
summary: A barbiturate derivative that is reported to have amnesic, hypnotic, and sedative properties, along with having similarties to other barbiturates. The drug is used in the treatment of epilepsy, short-term treatment for insomnia, and a preoperative medication for anaesthesia and anxiolysis for short surgical/diagnostic/therapeutic procedures.

pharmacology.text: It possesses anesthetic, anticonvulsant, anxiolytic, sedative, and hypnotic properties.

uses.text: Secobarbital, sold under the brand name Seconal among others, is a short-acting barbiturate drug originally used for the treatment of insomnia. It possesses anesthetic, anticonvulsant, anxiolytic, sedative, and hypnotic properties. It was widely abused, known on the street as "red devils" or "reds".
uses.recreational: Secobarbital was widely abused for recreational purposes in the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s, and accidental overdose was associated with the drug. Lilly's Seconal came in a bright orange/red bullet-shaped capsule known as a Pulvule. Prescription use of secobarbital decreased beginning in the early 1980s, by which time benzodiazepines had become increasingly common.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness, slurred speech and poor coordination. Overdose can slow or stop breathing and be fatal, regular use leads quickly to tolerance and dependence, and withdrawal can cause seizures and be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、頭暈、口齒不清和協調變差。過量可能使呼吸變慢或停止而致命，規律使用很快導致耐受性和依賴，戒斷可能引起癲癇發作並危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、头晕、口齿不清和协调制差。过量可能使呼吸变慢或停止而致命，规律使用很快导致耐受性和依赖，戒断可能引起癫痫发作并危及生命。

fact.en: Secobarbital, sold as Seconal, was one of the most widely used sleeping pills of the mid twentieth century, and its red capsules were nicknamed reds.
fact.zh: 西可巴比妥以 Seconal 之名販售，是二十世紀中期最廣泛使用的安眠藥之一，紅色膠囊被暱稱為「reds」。
fact.zhHans: 西可巴比妥以 Seconal 之名贩售，是二十世纪中期最广泛使用的安眠药之一，红色胶囊被暱称为「reds」。
